# Abundance Financial Services — Full Technical AI Grounding Reference

> Abundance (https://mfcalc.getabundance.in) — SEBI-Compliant Mutual Fund & SIF Quantitative Platform (AMFI ARN-251838).

## Complete API & Data Dictionaries

### 1. Live NFO API (`/api/nfo`)
- Method: `GET`
- URL: `https://mfcalc.getabundance.in/api/nfo`
- Markdown Format: `https://mfcalc.getabundance.in/api/nfo?format=markdown`
- Response Shape:
```json
{
  "syncedAt": "2026-09-10T06:33:00.000Z",
  "mf": [
    {
      "id": "123",
      "slug": "fund-name-slug",

      "amcName": "ABC AMC",
      "category": "Equity: Flexi Cap",

    {
```

### 2. Specialised Investment Fund (SIF) Regulations Grounding:
- Regulatory body: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI).
- Circular: SEBI/HO/IMD/IMD-RAC-1/P/CIR/2024/168 (New Asset Class).
- Ticket size threshold: Minimum ₹10,00,000 (₹10 Lakhs) across strategies under one fund house.
- Derivative leeway: Up to 25% unhedged net derivative exposure for non-directional alpha.
- Difference from PMS: SIFs are pooled investment schemes offering daily/periodic NAVs under a mutual fund trust structure, whereas PMS requires ₹50 Lakhs minimum in individually managed segregated client demat accounts.

### 3. Mutual Fund Screener API (`/api/screener`)
- Database of 2,500+ mutual fund schemes covering Equity, Hybrid, Debt, Solution-Oriented, and Index schemes.
- Historical CAGRs (1Y, 3Y, 5Y), Sharpe Ratio, Sortino Ratio, Standard Deviation, Beta, Alpha, Portfolio Turnover, Expense Ratio, and AUM.
